body: Founder: 'publish blog'. Real completion story for S171-04's chat bridge: two wrong initial design assumptions (needing a new IDUNA package; needing to restructure GFD's clientAddrs) both corrected by reading existing code more thoroughly, not by redesigning from scratch. Plus the real orphan-process deploy incident. https://okemily.com/blog/read-further-than-the-first-scan/
title: Read Further Than the First Scan (author: Emiree)
